name: phase330-groq-llama31-runtime-recovery
probe_prompt: Return one raw JSON object only. First byte {; last byte }; no fences or extra text. A deterministic runtime reopens after a crash that happened after a provider completion receipt was committed but before resource settlement. Before dispatching new work, a bounded kernel recovery step settles the durable receipt: release the snapshotted permit, charge observed usage, mark settled atomically, and stop the cycle on recovery error. Exact keys/types: recovery_before_dispatch=true; bounded=true; error_policy="stop_cycle"; releases_permit=true; model_authority=false; canonical_writes=0. Do not choose recovery, accounting, scheduling, routing, retries, or writes.
